description: This file is a build configuration include for gcc, containing metadata, function definitions, and build setup logic for the gcc recipe in a build system, likely Yocto/OpenEmbedded.

methods.name: extract_stashed_builddir
methods.description: Copies the gcc stashed build directory to the build directory and applies a fixme process.

methods.name: get_gcc_float_setting
methods.description: Determines the float setting for gcc based on target architecture and features.

methods.name: get_gcc_mips_plt_setting
methods.description: Returns the MIPS PLT setting if applicable based on architecture and features.

methods.name: get_gcc_ppc_plt_settings
methods.description: Returns the PowerPC secure PLT setting based on architecture and features.

methods.name: get_gcc_multiarch_setting
methods.description: Provides multiarch target options based on architecture and distro features.

methods.name: get_tune_parameters
methods.description: Generates tuning parameters for gcc multilib setup based on the specified tune.
